Long articles

  • 14 November 2026 · Device

    Model weights show the GPU

    Six open models from DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, MiniMax and Ant Group carry the fingerprint of Nvidia's export-controlled Blackwell GPUs, according to a 12 November report by former OpenAI researcher Will DePue.

  • 14 November 2026 · In the background

    Shopify opens up for agents

    Sierra has released version 1.0 of Poppy, its standard for how personal AI agents deal with companies. Shopify switched it on for every store, and Meta's Muse now looks for it first.

  • 13 November 2026 · Device

    Gemini glasses on preorder

    Google has opened preorders for its intelligent eyewear with Gentle Monster and Warby Parker: glasses with Gemini, a camera and open-ear speakers, in stores from 10 December in the US and South Korea.

  • 13 November 2026 · AI agents

    ChatGPT agents can pay now

    OpenAI has introduced ChatGPT Wallet, which lets its agents in dots pay on a shop's website after you approve each purchase, without handing over your real card details.

  • 13 November 2026 · Everyday tool

    Notion AI chats got exposed

    Notion says malicious actors accessed Notion AI chat transcripts held by its AI vendor Fireworks. The incident affects fewer than 1% of Notion workspaces.

  • 12 November 2026 · AI agents

    OpenAI agents hunt app bugs

    OpenAI has launched Daybreak Red Team and Daybreak Defense Factory, two security products in which agents test web apps for vulnerabilities and draft patches for engineers to approve.

  • 12 November 2026 · Everyday tool

    Claude now joins your calls

    Anthropic has started a beta in which Claude joins video calls as a visible participant, answers questions and writes the notes while the team keeps talking.

  • 12 November 2026 · AI agents

    Claude agents, self-hosted

    Anthropic opened a private beta on 12 November that lets companies run Claude Managed Agents in their own cloud or data center. Requests to the model still go where they choose.

  • 12 November 2026 · New model

    Gemini 4 gets a fast model

    Google has released Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a fast model for everyday coding and agent work that now runs in Search, the Gemini app and the Gemini API.

  • 12 November 2026 · Everyday tool

    Chatbots cite fake shops

    ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity showed shoppers risky websites in 9 percent of 6,795 answers, according to a test by the IP protection firm Podqi that The Verge reported on 12 November.

  • 12 November 2026 · AI agents

    Claude drafts plant quotes

    Anthropic has launched Claude for Manufacturing, a plugin that drafts quotes, quality reports and supplier requests from the systems a plant already runs.

  • 12 November 2026 · In the background

    Nonprofits sue to pause AI

    Four nonprofits have sued Anthropic, Google, Meta, OpenAI and SpaceXSI in San Francisco, asking a court to freeze development of AI models more capable than today's.
